_about: Quests (mine, 2026-11-01, from Robin's list: direction between bosses). A town offers one at a time to a character; up to three are carried; a town that was answered waits before it asks again. Rewards are the kind's numbers times the area's tier times the count; a hunt or a boss may add a unique of the tier.

hunt.text: Hunt down the {target} prowling the wilds.
